title: Native Resource Basic Finalizer
objective: Make generated Node resource holders safely self-finalizing with node_api_basic_finalize plus node_api_post_finalizer, expose a proven capability marker, and prevent redundant bootstrap finalizers while preserving portable fallback behavior

oracles: existing explicit-close lifecycle and generated FFI resource tests
controlled Node --expose-gc lifecycle fixture with clear-count and memory-accounting invariants

handoff.summary: Generated Node resource holders now clear only pure foreign state in node_api_basic_finalize, defer external-memory accounting and holder release through node_api_post_finalizer, publish an authenticated self-finalization capability, and let the bootstrap retain its JavaScript FinalizationRegistry only for unmarked or mismatched backends. Focused generated-resource, GC, worker-termination, mixed-adapter, ASan, UBSan, compiler, FLINT, strict-Python, architecture, and lifecycle-fuzz checks pass.
risks: The broad portable tier currently has one unrelated website reference-manual ID failure (21 !== 0); a dedicated website refresh lane is already addressing that generated artifact.
next_steps: Integrate the dedicated website refresh, rerun the portable tier, and then move this task to review.
